summary: Available September 2024 · Two Double Bedrooms · TV Included · City Centre Location · All Bills Inclusive Package Available
description:
My Property Box are delighted to offer this large 2 bedroom furnished student apartment situated in the City Centre directly opposite Fenwicks Department Store, The property is well presented and accommodation comprises; communal entrance with security video entry & private mail boxes, reception, generous open plan kitchen- living room with island with flat screen TV. The property is quadruple Glazed. Kitchen has dishwasher, washer/ dryer, electric hob and oven, electric heating. Pre Wired for Sky if desired, neutrally decorated and modern interior. No Parking.

To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
